summary: Owner-authorized turret bases persist and synchronize a bounded visual camouflage block state with configurable light emission and opacity.

authoritative_state: Camouflage block state, light emission and light opacity belong to TurretBaseBlockEntity.
The base BlockState contains only derived camouflaged and light-level render properties.

flows.purpose: Adjust bounded camouflage light values or clear camouflage in the currently open base session.
validation: The current TurretBaseMenu, containerId, position, dimension, distance, loaded BlockEntity identity and owner must match.
Light operands are integers in the inclusive range 0 through 15.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: Camouflage persistence, validation and light behavior remain available without loading the renderer.

generated: en_us and zh_cn camouflage controls and feedback
manual: Existing GPL-compatible turret base and configure GUI textures

budgets.scope: One visible camouflaged base per frame
budgets.measurement: One copied block model render with cached renderer and random source; no world scan.

performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.234 client and GameTest server.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Camouflage block state survives save/load, while data without camouflage fields defaults to no camouflage, light value 0 and opacity 15.
criteria.observation: A stone-camouflaged base reloads as stone; removing the three camouflage fields before load produces empty camouflage with light 0 and opacity 15.

criteria.statement: Only the owner can set or clear camouflage, and air, block-entity blocks and partial blocks are rejected.
criteria.observation: A non-owner set attempt and each invalid-state attempt return false; the owner can apply stone and clear it.

criteria.statement: Derived camouflaged and light-level BlockState values and opacity lookup.
criteria.observation: Derived camouflaged and light-level BlockState values and opacity lookup.

criteria.statement: All new locale keys and existing GUI/model resources resolve.
criteria.observation: All new locale keys and existing GUI/model resources resolve.

criteria.statement: No camouflage renderer class loads on a dedicated server.
criteria.observation: No camouflage renderer class loads on a dedicated server.

criteria.statement: Only a tier-five owner can set camouflage light value and opacity within 0 through 15.
criteria.observation: Tier-five owner calls accept boundary values and mirror LIGHT_LEVEL; out-of-range values and tier-three calls return false without changing defaults.

criteria.statement: Schema 4 camouflage light value and opacity survive a save/load round trip.
criteria.observation: After reloading a base saved with non-default camouflage light fields, both decoded values equal the values present before save.
